properties.title: Court Orders Benteler Automotive to Reinstate Worker After Shift Change Controversy
properties.summary: A court in Vigo, Spain, has ruled in favor of a Benteler Automotive worker, mandating the company to revert a forced shift change and accommodate the worker's family needs. Despite the legal ruling, the employer initially attempted to notify the worker of the shift change via WhatsApp, leading to further legal action. The court has now ordered the company to comply with the decision and reimburse the worker for the inconvenience caused.
